Audemars Piguet · ref. 77451OR

Royal Oak Selfwinding

Luxury sports · 34–41mm · 50m · automatic · 2012–2026

The Audemars Piguet Royal Oak Selfwinding is the foundational time-and-date model of the iconic Royal Oak family. It is defined by its octagonal bezel with exposed screws, integrated bracelet, and "Tapisserie" guilloché dial, establishing the luxury sports watch category.

The story

Introduced in 1972 with the reference 5402, the Royal Oak was a disruptive force in the watch industry, a luxury watch in a steel case with a price tag higher than many gold watches. Designed by Gérald Genta, its naval-inspired design was initially met with skepticism but soon gained traction, saving Audemars Piguet during the quartz crisis. Key evolutions in the Selfwinding line include the introduction of an in-house movement with the reference 15300 in 2005, a size increase to 41mm with the 15400 in 2012, and the debut of the new-generation Calibre 4302 in the 15500 in 2019. The family continues to evolve with the current 15510 reference, which introduced further ergonomic and aesthetic refinements for the Royal Oak's 50th anniversary in 2022.
